verdict.rationale: The pack never documents Notion AI or Custom Agents automatically triaging or prioritizing incoming bugs or tasks. The tagline "Keep work moving 24/7 with agents" is generic, and the Agent APIs only cover chat sessions and agent management. Webhooks, the REST API and MCP are developer building blocks someone could use to build triage, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
